title: The Carried Value: Basis Figure and Cover Cap Share
content:
# Costing Note: The Carried Value — Basis Figure and Cover Cap Share

This note defines the value a piece at the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service is carried at while the chain holds it, and works it to a figure.

## The quantities

**The basis figure.** The value the piece was taken in at.

**The whole of the basis figure.** The basis figure enters at the whole of itself, 100 percent, and the steps that bear on it are added to that whole.

**The steps that bear on the basis figure.** No step is added for coverage held on the piece. No step is added for the time the piece has been in the chain's hands.

**The evidenced share of the cover cap.** The narrow evidenced share, 10 percent of the level's own care and custody cover cap.

## The carried value

The release a customer signs for a piece the bench has in hand names the value the chain carries that piece at while it holds it, and that value is worked out from the papers standing on the piece rather than from the figure taken down over the counter. The value is the basis figure taken with the steps that bear on it added, and it is never more than the level's own care and custody cover cap taken at the evidenced share; the figure is rounded to the nearest cent. The value that stands is therefore the lower of the two: the basis figure with the steps added, and the cover cap taken at the evidenced share.

## Worked to a figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a hypothetical piece at a level whose care and custody cover cap is 40,000.00 USD, taken in at 3,000.00 USD.

- The basis figure is 3,000.00 USD, and with no step added it stands at 3,000.00 USD.
- The cover cap taken at the evidenced share of 10 percent is 4,000.00 USD.
- The carried value is the lower of 3,000.00 USD and 4,000.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent: 3,000.00 USD.

Had the same piece been taken in at 9,000.00 USD, the basis figure would stand at 9,000.00 USD, above the 4,000.00 USD the cover cap comes to at that share, and the carried value would be 4,000.00 USD.
